messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often must the 35,000 kg GCB 35 gantry crane at position 23 be verified?

response.text: Dato che l'azienda opera in aree minerarie (settore estrattivo), con quale frequenza deve essere verificata la gru a portale GCB 35 da 35.000 kg in posizione 23?
